cause_quote: The new settled branch used `summarizeToolGroup(visibleActivity)`, while routine calls were marked `hideFromChannelProgress: true`, so a step with only routine children still rendered as a count even when it was the sole visible operation.
user_saw: When a code-mode step with only routine nested calls finished, the Control UI chat showed “1 command” in place of its title and required two clicks to reach the details.
summary: The fix renders a lone completed step with only routine children as a titled disclosure and prevents double-counting when a visible descendant sits beneath a hidden call.
reasoning: The earlier grouped renderer already used counts after settlement, and #151456 carried that behavior into the new routine-filtered activity view even when only the parent step remained visible. The later #157438 change dropped the parent from the count and produced “Raw details,” while #165358 restored the count and left the collapsed title missing.
